mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ca_message(receiver_user_id,event_key,message_type,biz_type,biz_id,title,content,read_flag,create_time) VALUES(#{receiver},#{eventKey},#{type},#{bizType},#{bizId},#{title},#{content},'0',NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_key=VALUES(event_key)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ca_message WHERE receiver_user_id=#{userId} AND message_id IN #{id}
